text: Department of Business Management Department of business management is the first specialty in 60 years’ history. Till now, it has transported lots of special talented persons to the government , the industry and commerce ,the finance and other business units. In this department, there are 36% teachers are above associate profess .All-around teachers account for 40%. The teachers’ structure is reasonable and the teaching quality is high. This department exerts to raise senior special talented persons in the field of business management, the property circulation and international commerce.
